total_recorded_rows.definition: Total recorded 1-minute grid rows across all 45 participant CSV files (every file length Ni divisible by 5)
total_recorded_rows.inclusion_mask: all rows across all 45 participant files

total_dexcom_valid_rows.definition: Total non-null Dexcom G6 Pro observations in released 1-minute grid

total_libre_valid_rows.definition: Total non-null FreeStyle Libre Pro observations in released 1-minute grid

paired_overlap_rows.definition: Rows with concurrent non-null observations for both sensors on common 1-minute grid

dexcom_only_rows.definition: Rows with valid Dexcom reading but null Libre reading

libre_only_rows.definition: Rows with valid Libre reading but null Dexcom reading

neither_sensor_valid_rows.definition: Rows where both sensors are concurrently null

timestamp_contiguous_runs_all_rows.definition: Contiguous sequences across all 687,580 rows where consecutive timestamps step delta_t == 60s

dexcom_valid_contiguous_runs.definition: Contiguous sensor runs across 629,825 non-null Dexcom readings (step == 60s)

libre_valid_contiguous_runs.definition: Contiguous sensor runs across 687,360 non-null Libre readings (step == 60s)

dexcom_evaluated_runs_count.definition: Eligible Dexcom runs meeting length >= 120 min and >= 20 informative curvature bends

dexcom_evaluated_runs_valid_rows.definition: Eligible runs contained 625,728 of 629,825 valid one-minute-grid Dexcom rows (99.35% of valid rows in the released representation)
dexcom_evaluated_runs_valid_rows.inclusion_mask: valid Dexcom rows within eligible evaluated runs

dexcom_evaluated_runs_row_percentage.definition: Percentage of released 1-minute grid valid Dexcom rows audited in eligible runs (not physical sensor count)

dexcom_evaluated_runs_participant_covera.definition: Participants contributing at least one eligible evaluated run (100.0% cohort coverage)

dexcom_underpowered_short_runs_count.definition: Short runs with length < 120 minutes lacking statistical power for lattice inference

dexcom_underpowered_short_runs_valid_row.definition: Valid Dexcom rows contained in underpowered short runs (3,855 rows / 0.61%)

dexcom_underpowered_low_bends_runs_count.definition: Runs with length >= 120 min but < 20 informative curvature bends

dexcom_underpowered_low_bends_runs_valid.definition: Valid Dexcom rows contained in underpowered low-bend runs (242 rows / 0.04%)

dexcom_evaluated_run_compliance_rate.definition: Compliance rate across all 89 evaluated sessions under Time Semantics T6

dexcom_per_session_participant_complianc.definition: Cohort participant compliance under per-session inference (45/45 participants)

dexcom_global_forced_single_phase_rate.definition: Cohort participant compliance forcing global single phase across gaps (44/45)

libre_concordant_15min_rate.definition: Cohort participants concordant with published 15-minute sampling (44/45)

libre_metadata_discordant_count.definition: Participant Cluster 4 series mathematically satisfying 5m lattice but retained as METADATA-DISCORDANT

synthetic_core_suite_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate across frozen core 5-scenario benchmark suite (2,500 traces)

synthetic_blind_15m_jitter_unresolved_ra.definition: Unresolved rate on detector-blind 15-minute coordinate jitter (99/100)

synthetic_blind_15m_jitter_false_classif.definition: False confident classification rate on detector-blind 15m coordinate jitter (1/100)

set_b_uncensored_mean_difference_pooled.definition: Pooled grand mean difference (Libre - Dexcom) across 629,605 paired 1-minute rows

set_b_uncensored_mean_difference_equal_w.definition: Equal-weighted mean difference across 45 participant means

set_b_uncensored_sd_repeated_measures.definition: Repeated-measures standard deviation sqrt(var_between + var_within) under unbalanced RM-ANOVA

set_b_agreement_status.definition: Descriptive status denoting limits of agreement are exploratory due to unadjusted 1-minute serial autocorrelation

apparent_lag_median_minutes.definition: Median cross-correlation peak displacement (tau > 0 indicates Libre leads Dexcom; IQR [3.0, 7.0] min)

t2_hyperglycemia_180_dexcom.definition: Sustained hyperglycemia episodes (>180 mg/dL for >=15 min) detected on Dexcom (17 boundary-censored)
t2_hyperglycemia_180_dexcom.inclusion_mask: Dexcom contiguous runs, 5 mg/dL hysteresis release

t2_hyperglycemia_180_libre.definition: Sustained hyperglycemia episodes (>180 mg/dL for >=15 min) detected on Libre (7 boundary-censored)
t2_hyperglycemia_180_libre.inclusion_mask: Libre contiguous runs, 5 mg/dL hysteresis release

t2_hypoglycemia_70_dexcom.definition: Sustained hypoglycemia episodes (<70 mg/dL for >=15 min) detected on Dexcom (0 boundary-censored)
t2_hypoglycemia_70_dexcom.inclusion_mask: Dexcom contiguous runs, 5 mg/dL hysteresis release

t2_hypoglycemia_70_libre.definition: Sustained hypoglycemia episodes (<70 mg/dL for >=15 min) detected on Libre (58 boundary-censored)
t2_hypoglycemia_70_libre.inclusion_mask: Libre contiguous runs, 5 mg/dL hysteresis release

t3_reconciled_meal_events.definition: Reconciled self-logged nutritional meal events across cohort

frozen_config_hash.definition: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of frozen configs/stage1b.yaml

timestamp_integrity_audit_status.definition: Outcome of explicit file-by-file timestamp audit across all 45 participant CSVs (1,155 gaps, 1,200 runs)

time_of_day_preservation_status.definition: Date-shifting shifted whole days (CGMacros_dateshifted365.zip); intra-day clock time HH:MM preserved, confirmed by meal timings
